nml2e01.title: First Snow
nml2e01.caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: the first snow falls on the lane, and Cancer realises their best friend is the first person they want to tell everything. Crushes on friends are normal. Going quiet isn't the answer; showing up is.

nml2e02.title: The Market Stall
nml2e02.caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 2: the holiday market opens, and Sagittarius will not let anyone help. Not even Cancer. Letting someone hold the ladder isn't weakness. It's closeness. Practise saying yes, thank you.

nml2e03.title: The Borrowed Scarf
nml2e03.caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 3: day four of keeping the borrowed scarf, and Cancer has a nine-card speech ready. A gift can't say what you mean. One warm, simple line can.

nml2e04.title: Two Invitations, One Night
nml2e04.caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 4: Libra says yes to a party and a midnight bake on the same night. Splitting yourself in half means nobody gets you. Choose, then tell the other person kindly and early.

nml2e05.title: Snowed In
nml2e05.caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 5: the whole lane is snowed in at the café, a talk card goes round, and Sagittarius answers with a fun fact. When a moment gets real, try staying in it instead of joking your way out.

nmte01.title: The first snow
nmte01.caption:
The first snow, and your best friend suddenly looks different.
Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: a crush on a friend is allowed.

nmte02.title: Who do you tell first
nmte02.caption:
Who do you tell first when something good happens?
Cancer just found out the answer. Moonlight Lane, Ep 1.

nmte03.title: Hiding behind a croissant
nmte03.caption:
Ever hidden from someone you like? Behind a croissant?
Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: why vanishing never helps.

nmte04.title: I've got it
nmte04.caption:
Do you say 'I've got it' even when you don't?
Sagittarius, carrying a tower of lanterns alone. Moonlight Lane, Ep 2.

nmte05.title: Three no's
nmte05.caption:
Three offers of help. Three no's.
Why is yes, thank you so hard? Moonlight Lane, Ep 2.

nmte06.title: Shut out
nmte06.caption:
When you keep turning down help, the people offering start to feel shut out.
Moonlight Lane, Ep 2.

nmte07.title: Scarf or sign
nmte07.caption:
They lent you their scarf. It's been four days.
Is it a scarf, or a sign? Moonlight Lane, Ep 3.

nmte08.title: The nine-card speech
nmte08.caption:
Wrote a nine-card speech to return a scarf?
Cancer did, then hid in a snowbank. Moonlight Lane, Ep 3.

nmte09.title: One warm sentence
nmte09.caption:
Hoping a gift will say what you can't?
It won't. One warm sentence will. Moonlight Lane, Ep 3.

nmte10.title: Yes to both
nmte10.caption:
Two invitations for the same Saturday. You said yes to both.
Libra, this one's for you. Moonlight Lane, Ep 4.

nmte11.title: Party, bakery, party
nmte11.caption:
Party, bakery, party, bakery.
Half of you in two places is all of you in neither. Moonlight Lane, Ep 4.

nmte12.title: I just wanted you here
nmte12.caption:
'I just wanted you here.'
The cost of saying yes to everything. Moonlight Lane, Ep 4.

nmte13.title: One blanket left
nmte13.caption:
Snowed in at the café with the whole street, and one blanket left for you two.
Moonlight Lane, Ep 5.

nmte14.title: Joking it off
nmte14.caption:
Do you crack a joke whenever a moment gets real?
Sagittarius does. Moonlight Lane, Ep 5.

nmte15.title: A fact when it gets real
nmte15.caption:
'You always do a fact when it gets real.'
Why deflecting keeps people out. Moonlight Lane, Ep 5.
